subject: general
question: If (y + z) = 8 and yz = 6, find the value of (y - z)².
solution:
**Given:**

(y + z) = 8

(yz) = 6

(y - z)² = ?

**Concept used:**

(x - y)² = x² + y² - 2xy

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

(y + z) = 8

Squaring on both sides,

⇒ (y + z)² = (8)²

⇒ y² + 2yz + z² = 64

⇒ y² + 2(6) + z² = 64

⇒ y² + 12 + z² = 64

⇒ y² + z² = 64 - 12

⇒ y² + z² = 52

Now for (y - z)²

(y - z)2 = y² + z² - 2yz

⇒ (y - z)2 = 52 - 2(6)

⇒ (y - z)² = 52 - 12

⇒ (y - z)² = 40

**∴ The value of (y - z)2 is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**(x - y)2 = (x + y)2 - 4xy

(y - z)2 = (y + z)2 - 4yz

(y - z)2 = (8)2 - 4 x 6

(y - z)2 = 40
